title: A walk check runs after code lands, without anybody asking for one
goal: After a task lands app code, the loop is meant to run about ten minutes of scripted walks so a regression is caught the day it lands, and once a day to run the whole set. Today both only happen if a runner has asked for a sweep, and runners are told to ask only when they need the whole set. So since the full run of 2026-10-01 morning nobody asked, and seven app commits went in with no walk check at all. Make the checks happen on their own when code has landed.
notes:
Evidence, 2026-10-02 12:40Z, from the digest pass:
$ queue/bin/sweep-schedule.mjs --decide --locked
{"run":"nothing","why":"no sweep has been asked for","hoursSince":null,"nextFullInHours":null}
$ node queue/bin/loop-day.mjs --hours 24
  slices 0m 0.0% 0 rotating check(s)   (9 tasks ran in the same window)
$ ls queue/sweep/requested.json -> no such file
$ git log --since=2026-10-01T11:25 --format=%h -- Sources Scripts/playtest | wc -l -> 9
Cause: decide() in queue/bin/sweep-schedule.mjs returns nothing('no sweep has been asked for') before it looks at HEAD or the floor, and the whole-set run clears requested.json. Runner-prompt.md tells runners to ask only when they need the whole set, so nobody asks. Last rotating check: 2026-10-01T04:11Z. Last whole-set run: began 2026-10-01T15:28Z. CLAUDE.md promises 'after any task that lands code, a rotating check'. Fix likely: treat 'code landed under Sources/ or Scripts/playtest since rotation.lastHead / latest.head' as an implicit request, keep explicit requests for --now.
acceptance: With no sweep request pending, a task that lands code under Sources/ or Scripts/playtest/ is followed by a rotating check before the next task (subject to the existing locked-screen and person-at-Mac rules)
With no sweep request pending, the whole set still runs once the twenty four hour floor has passed and code has landed since the last whole-set run
A loop pass that lands only queue/ files (digest, task logs) does not trigger either
A drill in queue/bin moves the clock and HEAD through: code landed with no request, queue-only commit with no request, request pending, and shows the decision for each
CLAUDE.md, queue/README.md and runner-prompt.md describe what the code now does, in the same words
